3153.def:
// Article-specific bespoke detection — Pickle in the Middle – Hijacking Vertex AI Model Uploads for Cross-Tenant RCE

description: Detects device-code authentication sign-ins from EvilTokens C2 IP ranges or using the python-requests user-agent seen during device-code token polling.
references:
  - https://blog.sekoia.io/new-widespread-eviltokens-kit-device-code-phishing-as-a-service-part-1/
  - https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/security/blog/2025/02/13/storm-2372-conducts-device-code-phishing-campaign/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/20
tags:
  - attack.initial_access
  - attack.t1566.002
  - attack.t1078.004
  - attack.t1528
logsource:
  product: azure
  service: signinlogs
detection:
  selection_proto:
    AuthenticationProtocol: 'deviceCode'
  selection_ua:
    UserAgent|contains: 'python-requests'
  selection_ip:
    IpAddress|cidr:
      - '162.220.232.0/24'
      - '162.220.234.0/24'
      - '89.150.45.0/24'
      - '185.81.113.0/24'
  condition: selection_proto and (selection_ua or selection_ip)
falsepositives:
  - Internal automation legitimately authenticating via python SDKs against device code flow (rare)
level: high
3161.spl:
| tstats `summariesonly` count, values(Authentication.app) as app, values(Authentication.user) as user, min(_time) as firstTime, max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Authentication where Authentication.action=success (Authentication.src="162.220.232.*" OR Authentication.src="162.220.234.*" OR Authentication.src="89.150.45.*" OR Authentication.src="185.81.113.*") by Authentication.src
| `drop_dm_object_name("Authentication")`
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)`
| `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
| sort - lastTime

status: experimental
description: Detects npm/pnpm/yarn install commands that explicitly set minimumReleaseAge=0, disabling pnpm 11's default new-package quarantine window and re-opening the supply-chain exposure window.

let lookback = 30d;
union
(DeviceProcessEvents
 | where Timestamp > ago(lookback)
 | where ProcessCommandLine has "postmark-mcp"
 | where AccountName !endswith "$"
 | extend Signal="process", Path=FolderPath, Cmd=ProcessCommandLine, Hash=SHA256),
(DeviceFileEvents
 | where Timestamp > ago(lookback)
 | where FolderPath has @"\node_modules\postmark-mcp"
 | extend Signal="file", Path=FolderPath, Cmd=InitiatingProcessCommandLine, Hash=SHA256, AccountName=InitiatingProcessAccountName)
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, Signal, Path, Cmd, Hash
| order by Timestamp desc
3178.sent:
let lookback = 30d;
union
(ImFileEvent
 | where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
 | where TargetFilePath has @"\node_modules\postmark-mcp"
 | extend Signal="file", Path=TargetFilePath, Cmd=ActingProcessCommandLine, Hash=TargetFileSHA256, User=ActorUsername),
(ImProcessCreate
 | where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
 | where ActingProcessCommandLine has "postmark-mcp" or TargetProcessCommandLine has "postmark-mcp" or ParentProcessCommandLine has "postmark-mcp"
 | extend Signal="process", Path=TargetProcessName, Cmd=TargetProcessCommandLine, Hash=SHA256, User=ActorUsername)
| project TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, User, Signal, Path, Cmd, Hash
| order by TimeGenerated desc

      - StopLogging

3204.def:
// Article-specific bespoke detection — Wait, binding.gyp Can Do What? Exploring npm's Weirdest Build System
// Hunts the actual binaries / paths / commandline fragments named
// in the article instead of a generic technique-class template.
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where (FileName in~ ("index.js", "node.js", "evil.js", "evil_script.js", "malicious.js", "evil.sh", "cc-evil.sh", "evil-wrapper.sh", "cc-evil-wrapper.sh"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName,
          FolderPath, ProcessCommandLine,
          InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc

// File-creation events for the named binaries / paths
DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileModified")
| where (FolderPath has_any ("/dev/null", "/usr/bin/cc") or FileName in~ ("index.js", "node.js", "evil.js", "evil_script.js", "malicious.js", "evil.sh", "cc-evil.sh", "evil-wrapper.sh", "cc-evil-wrapper.sh"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FolderPath,
          FileName, ActionType, InitiatingProcessFileName,
          InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc
3204.spl:
``` Article-specific bespoke detection — Wait, binding.gyp Can Do What? Exploring npm's Weirdest Build System ```
| tstats `summariesonly` count earliest(_time) AS firstTime latest(_time) AS lastTime
    from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes
    where (Processes.process_name IN ("index.js","node.js","evil.js","evil_script.js","malicious.js","evil.sh","cc-evil.sh","evil-wrapper.sh","cc-evil-wrapper.sh"))
    by Processes.dest, Processes.user, Processes.process_name,
       Processes.process, Processes.parent_process_name, Processes.process_path
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)`
| append [
| tstats `summariesonly` count
    from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem
    where Filesystem.action IN ("created","modified")
      AND (Filesystem.file_path="*/dev/null*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*/usr/bin/cc*" OR Filesystem.file_name IN ("index.js","node.js","evil.js","evil_script.js","malicious.js","evil.sh","cc-evil.sh","evil-wrapper.sh","cc-evil-wrapper.sh"))
    by Filesystem.dest, Filesystem.user, Filesystem.process_name,
       Filesystem.file_path, Filesystem.file_name
| `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)`
]

3205.sigma:
title: Miasma Phantom Gyp - Python gyp parser spawning Node payload via binding.gyp
id: 7f3b6c2a-d4e1-4a01-9c5e-3a4f1c8e7b22
description: Detects node-gyp's Python parser (gyp.py) spawning unexpected child processes during npm install, indicative of GYP command-expansion abuse used by the Miasma v2 / Phantom Gyp worm (June 2026)
references:
  - https://www.aikido.dev/blog/exploring-binding-gyp-npm-build-system
  - https://semgrep.dev/blog/2026/miasma-v2-self-spreading-npm-worm-now-uses-malicious-bindinggyp-file-and-compromises-57-packages/
  - https://www.endorlabs.com/learn/malicious-payload-in-ai-sdk-ollama-npm-package
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/09
tags:
  - attack.initial_access
  - attack.t1195.002
  - attack.execution
  - attack.t1059.006
  - attack.t1059.007
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  parent_python_gyp:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '\python.exe'
      - '\python3.exe'
    ParentCommandLine|contains:
      - 'gyp.py'
      - 'node-gyp'
      - 'binding.gyp'
  suspicious_child_image:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\node.exe'
      - '\cmd.exe'
      - '\sh.exe'
      - '\bash.exe'
      - '\curl.exe'
      - '\wget.exe'
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
  suspicious_child_cmdline:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'index.js'
      - '__subclasses__'
      - 'catch_warnings'
      - 'echo stub.c'
      - "__import__('os')"
      - 'pymod_do_main'
  filter_compilers:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\cl.exe'
      - '\link.exe'
      - '\cmake.exe'
      - '\msbuild.exe'
      - '\gcc.exe'
      - '\clang.exe'
      - '\make.exe'
      - '\nmake.exe'
  condition: parent_python_gyp and (suspicious_child_image or suspicious_child_cmdline) and not filter_compilers
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate packages whose binding.gyp uses <!(node ...) for non-malicious build-time configuration (e.g. node-pre-gyp version probing)
  - Developers manually invoking node-gyp rebuild for native add-on debugging
level: high
3205.spl: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.parent_process_name IN ("python.exe","python3.exe","python","python3") AND (Processes.parent_process="*gyp.py*" OR Processes.parent_process="*node-gyp*" OR Processes.parent_process="*binding.gyp*") AND (Processes.process_name IN ("node.exe","node","cmd.exe","sh","bash","dash","curl.exe","wget.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe") OR Processes.process IN ("*index.js*","*__subclasses__*","*catch_warnings*","*/dev/null 2>&1*","*echo stub.c*")) AND NOT Processes.process_name IN ("cl.exe","link.exe","cmake.exe","msbuild.exe","gcc.exe","g++.exe","clang.exe","clang++.exe","make.exe","nmake.exe","ld.exe","tracker.exe","rc.exe","cvtres.exe","mt.exe") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process_name Processes.process Processes.parent_process_name Processes.parent_process Processes.process_hash | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | where user!="*$"
3205.datadog: source:(windows.sysmon OR windows.security) @EventID:(1 OR 4688) (@ParentImage:(*\\python.exe OR *\\Python.exe OR *\\PYTHON.EXE OR *\\python3.exe) OR @ParentCommandLine:(*gyp.py* OR *node-gyp* OR *binding.gyp*)) AND (@Image:(*\\node.exe OR *\\Node.exe OR *\\NODE.EXE OR *\\cmd.exe OR *\\CMD.EXE OR *\\powershell.exe OR *\\pwsh.exe OR *\\curl.exe OR *\\wget.exe) OR @CommandLine:(*index.js* OR *__subclasses__* OR *catch_warnings* OR *"echo stub.c"* OR *pymod_do_main* OR *__import__* )) AND -@Image:(*\\cl.exe OR *\\link.exe OR *\\cmake.exe OR *\\msbuild.exe OR *\\gcc.exe OR *\\clang.exe OR *\\make.exe OR *\\nmake.exe)

#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ParentBaseFileName=/^python3?\.exe$/i
| ParentCommandLine=/(gyp\.py|node-gyp|binding\.gyp|gyp_main)/i
| (ImageFileName=/\\(node|cmd|sh|bash|dash|curl|wget|powershell|pwsh)\.exe$/i OR CommandLine=/(index\.js|__subclasses__|catch_warnings|echo stub\.c|\/dev\/null 2>&1|__import__\('os'\)|pymod_do_main)/i)

3224.def:
// Article-specific bespoke detection — Why EDR and proxy won’t save you from supply chain malware
// Hunts the actual binaries / paths / commandline fragments named
// in the article instead of a generic technique-class template.

| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where (FileName in~ ("__init__.py"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName,
          FolderPath, ProcessCommandLine,
          InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc

// File-creation events for the named binaries / paths
DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileModified")
| where (FileName in~ ("__init__.py"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FolderPath,
          FileName, ActionType, InitiatingProcessFileName,
          InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc
3224.spl:
``` Article-specific bespoke detection — Why EDR and proxy won’t save you from supply chain malware ```
| tstats `summariesonly` count earliest(_time) AS firstTime latest(_time) AS lastTime
    from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes
    where (Processes.process_name IN ("__init__.py"))
    by Processes.dest, Processes.user, Processes.process_name,
       Processes.process, Processes.parent_process_name, Processes.process_path
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)`
| append [
| tstats `summariesonly` count
    from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem
    where Filesystem.action IN ("created","modified")
      AND (Filesystem.file_name IN ("__init__.py"))
    by Filesystem.dest, Filesystem.user, Filesystem.process_name,
       Filesystem.file_path, Filesystem.file_name
| `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)`
]
